messages.text: Can you clean up this kitchen pic by clearing the loose clutter off the counter, rather than doing a renovation? I keep getting distracted by the mess when I look at it, so I’d love to see it tidied up. You can decide which loose items to remove, but please keep the brown cabinets, beige tiles, counter material and existing kitchen layout as they are. I just mean a cleanup of what’s sitting out, with the image staying a realistic photo in the same wide framing. Free-tier resolution is fine.
